```{r}
# Parameters

params_fixed <- list(

  # ART initiation
  gammaF = 0.85,
  gammaM = 0.89,

  # Natural mortality
  muF = 0.02,
  muM = 0.02,

  # HIV related mortality for untreated FSW and MC
  thetaF = 0.1,
  thetaM = 0.1,
  
  # Mortality among those on ART
  thetaTF = 0.01,
  thetaTM = 0.01,

  # Transmission probabilities
  betaMF = 0.0008,   # male client -> fsw
  betaFM = 0.0004,   # fsw -> male client

  # Contact rates
  cF = 1550,
  cM = 500,

  # Relative infectiousness on ART
  fT = 0.03,

  # Condom intervention
  condom_eff = 0.76,
  condom_covF = 0.50,
  condom_covM = 0.6,

  # PrEP intervention
  PrEP_eff = 0.53,
  PrEP_covF = 0.32,
  PrEP_covM = 0.60,

  # Circumcision
  
  circ_eff = 0.55,
  circ_cov = 0.50
)
```
```{r}
# Model function

model <- function(t, state, p) {

  with(as.list(c(state, p)), {

    # Total populations
    NF <- SF + IF + TF
    NM <- SM + IM + TM

    # Recruitment balances natural mortality
    recruitF <- muF * NF + thetaF * IF + thetaTF * TF
    recruitM <- muM * NM + thetaM * IM + thetaTM * TM

    # Infectious prevalence, accounting for reduced
    # infectiousness among people receiving ART
    prev_M <- (IM + fT * TM) / NM
    prev_F <- (IF + fT * TF) / NF

    # Effective condom coverage:
    # probability that at least one partner uses a condom
    condom_cov_eff <- 1 -
      (1 - condom_covF) * (1 - condom_covM)

    # Condom protection applies in both directions
    red_condom <- 1 -
      condom_eff * condom_cov_eff

    # Susceptibility reductions in the correct populations
    red_F <- red_condom *
      (1 - PrEP_eff * PrEP_covF)

    red_M <- red_condom *
      (1 - PrEP_eff * PrEP_covM) *
      (1 - circ_eff * circ_cov)

    # Forces of infection
    lambdaF <- cF * betaMF * red_F * prev_M

    lambdaM <- cM * betaFM * red_M * prev_F

    # Female sex workers
    dSF <- recruitF - lambdaF * SF - muF * SF

    dIF <- lambdaF * SF -
      (gammaF + muF + thetaF) * IF

    dTF <- gammaF * IF -
      (muF + thetaTF) * TF

    # Male clients
    dSM <- recruitM - lambdaM * SM - muM * SM

    dIM <- lambdaM * SM -
      (gammaM + muM + thetaM) * IM

    dTM <- gammaM * IM -
      (muM + thetaTM) * TM

    # Incidence rates
    incF <- lambdaF * SF
    incM <- lambdaM * SM

    list(
      c(dSF, dIF, dTF, dSM, dIM, dTM),
      incF = incF,
      incM = incM
    )
  })
}
```

```{r}
# Run model
run_model <- function(p){

  as.data.frame(
    ode(
      y = state,
      times = times,
      func = model,
      parms = p
    )
  )
}
# Expected infectiousness-weighted duration in each population
infectious_duration_F <- function(p) {
  1 / (p$gammaF + p$muF + p$thetaF) +
    p$fT * p$gammaF /
    ((p$gammaF + p$muF + p$thetaF) *
       (p$muF + p$thetaTF))
}

infectious_duration_M <- function(p) {
  1 / (p$gammaM + p$muM + p$thetaM) +
    p$fT * p$gammaM /
    ((p$gammaM + p$muM + p$thetaM) *
       (p$muM + p$thetaTM))
}

# Next-generation matrix calculation
# Infected-state order: IF, TF, IM, TM

calculate_ngm <- function(p, state_now = NULL,
                           interventions = FALSE) {

  # Progression and exit rates
  aF <- p$gammaF + p$muF + p$thetaF
  bF <- p$muF + p$thetaTF

  aM <- p$gammaM + p$muM + p$thetaM
  bM <- p$muM + p$thetaTM

  # Prevention multipliers
  red_F <- 1
  red_M <- 1

  if (interventions) {

    condom_cov_eff <- 1 -
      (1 - p$condom_covF) *
      (1 - p$condom_covM)

    red_condom <- 1 - p$condom_eff * condom_cov_eff

    red_F <- red_condom *
      (1 - p$PrEP_eff * p$PrEP_covF)

    red_M <- red_condom *
      (1 - p$PrEP_eff * p$PrEP_covM) *
      (1 - p$circ_eff * p$circ_cov)
  }

  # Susceptible proportions:
  # At the disease-free equilibrium, both are 1.
  if (is.null(state_now)) {
    sF <- 1
    sM <- 1
  } else {
    NF <- sum(state_now[c("SF", "IF", "TF")])
    NM <- sum(state_now[c("SM", "IM", "TM")])

    sF <- as.numeric(state_now["SF"] / NF)
    sM <- as.numeric(state_now["SM"] / NM)
  }

  # New infection matrix F
  # Rows/columns: IF, TF, IM, TM
  F <- matrix(
    0, nrow = 4, ncol = 4,
    dimnames = list(
      c("IF", "TF", "IM", "TM"),
      c("IF", "TF", "IM", "TM")
    )
  )

  F["IF", "IM"] <- p$cF * p$betaMF * red_F * sF
  F["IF", "TM"] <- p$cF * p$betaMF * red_F * sF * p$fT

  F["IM", "IF"] <- p$cM * p$betaFM * red_M * sM
  F["IM", "TF"] <- p$cM * p$betaFM * red_M * sM * p$fT

  # Transition matrix V
  V <- matrix(
    0, nrow = 4, ncol = 4,
    dimnames = list(
      c("IF", "TF", "IM", "TM"),
      c("IF", "TF", "IM", "TM")
    )
  )

  V["IF", "IF"] <- aF
  V["TF", "IF"] <- -p$gammaF
  V["TF", "TF"] <- bF

  V["IM", "IM"] <- aM
  V["TM", "IM"] <- -p$gammaM
  V["TM", "TM"] <- bM

  # Next-generation matrix
  K <- F %*% solve(V)

  list(F = F, V = V, K = K)
}

# Basic reproduction number for a completely untreated epidemic
# No ART, condoms, PrEP, or circumcision

calc_R0_untreated <- function(p) {

  # Exit rates for untreated HIV-infected individuals
  # Natural mortality + HIV-related mortality
  aF <- p$muF + p$thetaF
  aM <- p$muM + p$thetaM

  # New infection matrix
  # Infected-state order: IF, IM
  F <- matrix(
    c(
      0,                  p$cF * p$betaMF,
      p$cM * p$betaFM,    0
    ),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(
      c("IF", "IM"),
      c("IF", "IM")
    )
  )

  # Transition matrix: no ART initiation or ART compartments
  V <- diag(
    c(aF, aM),
    nrow = 2,
    ncol = 2
  )

  dimnames(V) <- list(
    c("IF", "IM"),
    c("IF", "IM")
  )

  # Next-generation matrix
  K <- F %*% solve(V)

  # R0 is the spectral radius of the next-generation matrix
  R0 <- max(Mod(eigen(K)$values))

  return(R0)
}

# Re: interventions and susceptible proportions included
calc_Re_NGM <- function(p, state_now) {

  matrices <- calculate_ngm(
    p,
    state_now = state_now,
    interventions = TRUE
  )

  max(Mod(eigen(matrices$K)$values))
}


# Basic reproduction number: no condoms, PrEP or circumcision

calc_R0 <- function(p) {
  calc_R0_untreated(p)
}

calc_Re <- function(p, state_now) {
  calc_Re_NGM(p, state_now)
}

# Inspect the matrices
ngm <- calculate_ngm(params_fixed)

ngm$F
ngm$V
ngm$K

# Independent analytical R0 calculation
calc_R0_analytic <- function(p) {

  aF <- p$muF + p$thetaF
  aM <- p$muM + p$thetaM

  K_MF <- p$cF * p$betaMF / aM
  K_FM <- p$cM * p$betaFM / aF

  sqrt(K_MF * K_FM)
}

# Compare analytical formula against the NGM
comparison <- data.frame(
  Method = c(
    "Analytical formula: untreated R0",
    "Next-generation matrix: untreated R0"
  ),
  R0 = c(
    calc_R0_analytic(params_fixed),
    calc_R0_untreated(params_fixed)
  )
)

print(comparison)

if (!isTRUE(all.equal(
  comparison$R0[1],
  comparison$R0[2],
  tolerance = 1e-6
))) {
  stop("Untreated R0 validation failed.")
} else {
  cat("Untreated R0 validation passed.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#Run models based on different scenarios
evaluate_model <- function(p) {

  out <- run_model(p)

  FSW_prev <- tail(
    (out$IF + out$TF) /
      (out$SF + out$IF + out$TF), 1
  )

  MC_prev <- tail(
    (out$IM + out$TM) /
      (out$SM + out$IM + out$TM), 1
  )

  state_end <- c(
    SF = tail(out$SF, 1),
    IF = tail(out$IF, 1),
    TF = tail(out$TF, 1),
    SM = tail(out$SM, 1),
    IM = tail(out$IM, 1),
    TM = tail(out$TM, 1)
  )

  data.frame(
    FSW_prev = as.numeric(FSW_prev),
    MC_prev  = as.numeric(MC_prev),
    R0 = calc_R0_untreated(p),
    Re = calc_Re_NGM(p, state_end)
  )

}

# Scenario 1: Literature-based model without calibration
scenario1 <- params_fixed

res1 <- evaluate_model(scenario1)

res1

#Scenario 2: Calibrating transmission probabilities only
objective_beta <- function(par){

  p <- params_fixed

  p$betaMF <- par[1]
  p$betaFM <- par[2]

  out <- run_model(p)

  FSW_prev <- tail(
    (out$IF + out$TF) /
      (out$SF + out$IF + out$TF), 1)

  MC_prev <- tail(
    (out$IM + out$TM) /
      (out$SM + out$IM + out$TM), 1)

  err_FSW <- (FSW_prev - 0.375)^2
  err_MC  <- (MC_prev - 0.175)^2

  return(err_FSW + err_MC)

}
 
fit2 <- optim(
  par = c(0.003,0.001),
  fn = objective_beta,
  method = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower = c(0.001,0.0003),
  upper = c(0.01,0.005)
)
# Check optimizer convergence
print(fit2$convergence)
print(fit2$message)
print(fit2$par)

if (fit2$convergence != 0) {
  stop("Scenario 2 did not converge. Refit using multiple starting values.")
}

scenario2 <- params_fixed

scenario2$betaMF <- fit2$par[1]
scenario2$betaFM <- fit2$par[2]

res2 <- evaluate_model(scenario2)
# Inspect final calibrated parameters
print(scenario2)

# Evaluate the final model
final_results <- evaluate_model(scenario2)
print(final_results)


# Scenario 3: optimization (upper-bound solution)
objective_contact <- function(par){

  p <- params_fixed

  p$cF <- par[1]
  p$cM <- par[2]

  out <- run_model(p)

  FSW_prev <- tail(
    (out$IF + out$TF) /
      (out$SF + out$IF + out$TF), 1)

  MC_prev <- tail(
    (out$IM + out$TM) /
      (out$SM + out$IM + out$TM), 1)

  err_FSW <- (FSW_prev - 0.375)^2
  err_MC  <- (MC_prev - 0.175)^2

  return(err_FSW + err_MC)
  
}
#Diagnostics
# One: Diagnose whether the objective responds to contact rates

contact_test <- data.frame(
  cF = c(800, 1200, 1550, 2000, 3000, 4000),
  cM = c(20, 100, 300, 500, 800, 1200)
)

contact_test$Objective <- mapply(
  function(cf, cm) {
    objective_contact(c(cf, cm))
  },
  contact_test$cF,
  contact_test$cM
)

print(contact_test, digits = 8)

# STEP 2: Vary cF while keeping cM fixed

test_cF <- data.frame(
  cF = seq(800, 4000, by = 200)
)

test_cF$Objective <- sapply(
  test_cF$cF,
  function(x) {
    objective_contact(c(x, params_fixed$cM))
  }
)

print(test_cF, digits = 8)


# STEP 3: Vary cM while keeping cF fixed

test_cM <- data.frame(
  cM = seq(20, 1200, by = 20)
)

test_cM$Objective <- sapply(
  test_cM$cM,
  function(x) {
    objective_contact(c(params_fixed$cF, x))
  }
)

# STEP 4: Numerical gradient diagnostic

x0 <- c(
  cF = params_fixed$cF,
  cM = params_fixed$cM
)

f0 <- objective_contact(x0)

h <- c(
  cF = 1,
  cM = 1
)

gradient_check <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(x0),
  Objective_at_start = f0,
  Forward_difference = NA_real_,
  Backward_difference = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_along(x0)) {

  x_plus <- x0
  x_minus <- x0

  x_plus[i] <- x_plus[i] + h[i]
  x_minus[i] <- x_minus[i] - h[i]

  gradient_check$Forward_difference[i] <-
    (objective_contact(x_plus) - f0) / h[i]

  gradient_check$Backward_difference[i] <-
    (f0 - objective_contact(x_minus)) / h[i]
}

print(gradient_check, digits = 10)

fit3 <- optim(
  par = c(1550,500),
  fn = objective_contact,
  method = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower = c(800,20),
  upper = c(4000,1200)
)

# Scenario 3: Scaled contact-rate optimization

objective_contact_scaled <- function(x) {
  objective_contact(c(x[1] * 1000, x[2] * 1000))
}

fit3_scaled <- optim(
  par = c(1.55, 0.50),
  fn = objective_contact_scaled,
  method = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower = c(0.8, 0.02),
  upper = c(4.0, 1.2),
  control = list(maxit = 2000, factr = 1e4)
)

# Display results
print(fit3_scaled$par * 1000)
print(fit3_scaled$value)
print(fit3_scaled$convergence)
print(fit3_scaled$message)

# Confirm the objective using the fitted scaled parameters
print(
  objective_contact(
    fit3_scaled$par * 1000
  )
)

# Scenario 3: Using the scaled optimizer's fitted parameters

scenario3 <- params_fixed

scenario3$cF <- as.numeric(fit3_scaled$par[1] * 1000)
scenario3$cM <- as.numeric(fit3_scaled$par[2] * 1000)

# Evaluate the model using the fitted contact rates
res3 <- evaluate_model(scenario3)

# Compare initial and fitted contact rates
contact_comparison <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("cF", "cM"),
  Initial = c(params_fixed$cF, params_fixed$cM),
  Fitted = c(scenario3$cF, scenario3$cM)
)

print(contact_comparison)

# Compare targets with fitted prevalence
prevalence_comparison <- data.frame(
  Population = c("FSW", "Male clients"),
  Target = c(0.375, 0.175),
  Fitted = c(res3$FSW_prev, res3$MC_prev)
)

prevalence_comparison$Absolute_Error <- abs(
  prevalence_comparison$Target -
    prevalence_comparison$Fitted
)

print(prevalence_comparison)

# Verify the objective
print(objective_contact(c(scenario3$cF, scenario3$cM)))

# Scenario 4: Joint calibration to prevalence only
objective_joint <- function(par){

  p <- params_fixed

  p$betaMF <- par[1]
  p$betaFM <- par[2]
  p$cF <- par[3]
  p$cM <- par[4]

  out <- run_model(p)

  FSW_prev <- tail(
    (out$IF + out$TF) /
      (out$SF + out$IF + out$TF), 1)

  MC_prev <- tail(
    (out$IM + out$TM) /
      (out$SM + out$IM + out$TM), 1)

   err_FSW <- (FSW_prev - 0.375)^2
  err_MC  <- (MC_prev - 0.175)^2

  return(err_FSW + err_MC)

}

fit4 <- optim(
  par = c(0.003,0.001,1000,300),
  fn = objective_joint,
  method = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower = c(0.001,0.0003,800,20),
  upper = c(0.01,0.005,4000,1200)
)
print(fit4$convergence)
print(fit4$message)

scenario4 <- params_fixed

scenario4$betaMF <- fit4$par[1]
scenario4$betaFM <- fit4$par[2]
scenario4$cF     <- fit4$par[3]
scenario4$cM     <- fit4$par[4]

res4 <- evaluate_model(scenario4)

# Compare all calibration scenarios
scenario_comparison <- data.frame(
  Scenario = c(
    "Scenario 1: Literature-based",
    "Scenario 2: Transmission probabilities calibrated",
    "Scenario 3: Contact rates optimization (upper-bound solution)",
    "Scenario 4: Joint calibration"
  ),
  rbind(res1, res2, res3, res4)
)

print(scenario_comparison, digits = 4)
```

```{r intervention-scenarios}
# Final calibrated parameter set
base_p <- scenario2

# No-intervention comparator
p_none <- base_p
p_none$condom_covF <- 0
p_none$condom_covM <- 0
p_none$PrEP_covF <- 0
p_none$PrEP_covM <- 0
p_none$circ_cov <- 0

# Intensified condom coverage, retaining baseline PrEP/circumcision
p_condoms <- base_p
p_condoms$condom_covF <- 0.85
p_condoms$condom_covM <- 0.85

# Intensified PrEP coverage, retaining baseline condoms/circumcision
p_prep <- base_p
p_prep$PrEP_covF <- 0.90
p_prep$PrEP_covM <- 0.90

# Intensified circumcision coverage, retaining baseline condoms/PrEP
p_circ <- base_p
p_circ$circ_cov <- 0.90

# Intensified condoms and PrEP, retaining baseline circumcision
p_condoms_prep <- base_p
p_condoms_prep$condom_covF <- 0.85
p_condoms_prep$condom_covM <- 0.85
p_condoms_prep$PrEP_covF <- 0.90
p_condoms_prep$PrEP_covM <- 0.90

# Intensified condoms and circumcision, retaining baseline PrEP
p_condoms_circ <- base_p
p_condoms_circ$condom_covF <- 0.85
p_condoms_circ$condom_covM <- 0.85
p_condoms_circ$circ_cov <- 0.90

# Intensified PrEP and circumcision, retaining baseline condoms
p_prep_circ <- base_p
p_prep_circ$PrEP_covF <- 0.90
p_prep_circ$PrEP_covM <- 0.90
p_prep_circ$circ_cov <- 0.90

# All interventions intensified
p_all <- base_p
p_all$condom_covF <- 0.85
p_all$condom_covM <- 0.85
p_all$PrEP_covF <- 0.90
p_all$PrEP_covM <- 0.90
p_all$circ_cov <- 0.90

# Define intervention scenarios
scenarios <- list(
  Baseline = base_p,
  No_Intervention = p_none,
  Condoms_Added = p_condoms,
  PrEP_Added = p_prep,
  Circumcision_Added = p_circ,
  Condoms_PrEP = p_condoms_prep,
  Condoms_Circumcision = p_condoms_circ,
  PrEP_Circumcision = p_prep_circ,
  All_Interventions = p_all
)

# Run each scenario
outputs <- lapply(scenarios, run_model)

# Calculate terminal prevalence, R0, Re and integrated incidence
summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(outputs), function(n) {

  out <- outputs[[n]]
  p <- scenarios[[n]]

  FSW_prev <- tail(
    (out$IF + out$TF) /
      (out$SF + out$IF + out$TF),
    1
  )

  MC_prev <- tail(
    (out$IM + out$TM) /
      (out$SM + out$IM + out$TM),
    1
  )

  state_end <- c(
    SF = tail(out$SF, 1),
    IF = tail(out$IF, 1),
    TF = tail(out$TF, 1),
    SM = tail(out$SM, 1),
    IM = tail(out$IM, 1),
    TM = tail(out$TM, 1)
  )

  data.frame(
    Scenario = n,
    FSW_prev = as.numeric(FSW_prev),
    MC_prev = as.numeric(MC_prev),
    R0 = calc_R0_untreated(p),
    Re_terminal = calc_Re_NGM(p, state_end),
    FSW_integrated_incidence = pracma::trapz(
      out$time, out$incF
    ),
    MC_integrated_incidence = pracma::trapz(
      out$time, out$incM
    )
  )
}))

# Reductions relative to the no-intervention scenario
no_int <- summary_table[
  summary_table$Scenario == "No_Intervention", ]

summary_table$FSW_reduction_vs_none <- 100 * (
  1 - summary_table$FSW_prev / no_int$FSW_prev
)

summary_table$MC_reduction_vs_none <- 100 * (
  1 - summary_table$MC_prev / no_int$MC_prev
)

# Incremental reductions relative to baseline
baseline <- summary_table[
  summary_table$Scenario == "Baseline", ]

summary_table$FSW_reduction_vs_baseline <- 100 * (
  1 - summary_table$FSW_prev / baseline$FSW_prev
)

summary_table$MC_reduction_vs_baseline <- 100 * (
  1 - summary_table$MC_prev / baseline$MC_prev
)

# Display results
summary_table_print <- summary_table
numeric_cols <- vapply(summary_table_print, is.numeric, logical(1))
summary_table_print[numeric_cols] <- lapply(
  summary_table_print[numeric_cols],
  round,
  digits = 3
)

print(summary_table_print, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Run all intervention scenarios
outputs <- lapply(scenarios, run_model)

# Create intervention summary
summary_table <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(scenarios), function(n) {

    out <- outputs[[n]]
    p <- scenarios[[n]]

    # Terminal prevalence
    FSW_prev <- tail(
      (out$IF + out$TF) /
        (out$SF + out$IF + out$TF), 1
    )

    MC_prev <- tail(
      (out$IM + out$TM) /
        (out$SM + out$IM + out$TM), 1
    )

    # Terminal state for effective reproduction number
    state_end <- c(
      SF = tail(out$SF, 1),
      IF = tail(out$IF, 1),
      TF = tail(out$TF, 1),
      SM = tail(out$SM, 1),
      IM = tail(out$IM, 1),
      TM = tail(out$TM, 1)
    )

    data.frame(
      Scenario = n,
      FSW_prev = FSW_prev,
      MC_prev = MC_prev,
      R0 = calc_R0(p),
      Re_terminal = calc_Re(p, state_now = state_end),

      # Integrated incidence over the simulation period
      FSW_cum_inc = pracma::trapz(
        out$time, out$incF
      ),
      MC_cum_inc = pracma::trapz(
        out$time, out$incM
      )
    )
  })
)

# INTERVENTION EFFECTIVENESS
# Reference: No-intervention scenario
reference_FSW <- summary_table$FSW_prev[
  summary_table$Scenario == "No_Intervention"
]

reference_MC <- summary_table$MC_prev[
  summary_table$Scenario == "No_Intervention"
]

if (length(reference_FSW) != 1 ||
    length(reference_MC) != 1 ||
    !is.finite(reference_FSW) ||
    !is.finite(reference_MC) ||
    reference_FSW <= 0 ||
    reference_MC <= 0) {
  stop("Invalid no-intervention reference prevalence.")
}

# Percentage reduction compared with no intervention
summary_table$FSW_reduction_pct <-
  100 * (1 - summary_table$FSW_prev / reference_FSW)

summary_table$MC_reduction_pct <-
  100 * (1 - summary_table$MC_prev / reference_MC)

# Rank by FSW prevalence reduction
summary_table <- summary_table[
  order(
    summary_table$FSW_reduction_pct,
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
]

# Print a rounded results table
summary_table_print <- summary_table

numeric_cols <- vapply(
  summary_table_print,
  is.numeric,
  logical(1)
)

summary_table_print[numeric_cols] <- lapply(
  summary_table_print[numeric_cols],
  round,
  digits = 3
)

print(summary_table_print)
# RANKED INTERVENTION EFFECTIVENESS

rank_df <- subset(
  summary_table,
  !(Scenario %in% c("Baseline", "No_Intervention"))
)

# Order interventions by FSW reduction
rank_df$Scenario <- factor(
  rank_df$Scenario,
  levels = rank_df$Scenario[
    order(rank_df$FSW_reduction_pct)
  ]
)

rank_long <- data.frame(
  Scenario = rep(rank_df$Scenario, 2),

  Population = factor(
    c(
      rep("FSW", nrow(rank_df)),
      rep("Male Clients", nrow(rank_df))
    ),
    levels = c("FSW", "Male Clients")
  ),

  Reduction_pct = c(
    rank_df$FSW_reduction_pct,
    rank_df$MC_reduction_pct
  )
)

ggplot(
  rank_long,
  aes(
    x = Scenario,
    y = Reduction_pct,
    fill = Population
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Reduction in HIV Prevalence by Intervention",
    subtitle = "Relative to the no-intervention scenario at year 10",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Reduction in prevalence (%)",
    fill = "Population"
  )
```

```{r}
# 1. Define sensitivity ranges
# These are illustrative levels; justify final ranges using
# literature, programme data, or documented parameter bounds.

sens_grid <- expand.grid(

  betaMF_scale = c(0.75, 1.00, 1.25),
  betaFM_scale = c(0.75, 1.00, 1.25),

  condom_covF = c(0.20, 0.50, 0.80),
  condom_covM = c(0.20, 0.50, 0.80),

  PrEP_covF = c(0.00, 0.30, 0.60),
  PrEP_covM = c(0.00, 0.30, 0.60),

  circ_cov = c(0.20, 0.50, 0.80)
)

# 3^7 = 2,187 parameter combinations
nrow(sens_grid)

# 2. Run the model for each parameter combination
sens_list <- vector("list", nrow(sens_grid))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(sens_grid))) {

# Start with the same calibrated parameter set each time
  p <- p_all

  # Vary transmission probabilities independently
  p$betaMF <- p_all$betaMF *
    sens_grid$betaMF_scale[i]

  p$betaFM <- p_all$betaFM *
    sens_grid$betaFM_scale[i]

  # Vary condom coverage in both populations
  p$condom_covF <- sens_grid$condom_covF[i]
  p$condom_covM <- sens_grid$condom_covM[i]

  # Vary PrEP coverage in both populations
  p$PrEP_covF <- sens_grid$PrEP_covF[i]
  p$PrEP_covM <- sens_grid$PrEP_covM[i]

  # Vary male circumcision coverage
  p$circ_cov <- sens_grid$circ_cov[i]

  # Run model safely
  out <- tryCatch(
    run_model(p),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  # Record failed simulations rather than stopping the loop
  if (is.null(out)) {

    sens_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      sens_grid[i, ],
      FSW_prev = NA_real_,
      MC_prev = NA_real_,
      FSW_integrated_incidence = NA_real_,
      MC_integrated_incidence = NA_real_
    )

    next
  }

  # Confirm required outputs are available
  required_cols <- c(
    "time", "SF", "IF", "TF",
    "SM", "IM", "TM", "incF", "incM"
  )

  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(out))) {
    stop(
      "The model output is missing required columns. ",
      "Check run_model() and its output names."
    )
  }

  # Year-10 prevalence
  FSW_prev <- tail(
    (out$IF + out$TF) /
      (out$SF + out$IF + out$TF),
    1
  )

  MC_prev <- tail(
    (out$IM + out$TM) /
      (out$SM + out$IM + out$TM),
    1
  )

  # Integrated incidence over the simulation period
  # individual-level infection probabilities.
  FSW_int_inc <- pracma::trapz(
    out$time, out$incF
  )

  MC_int_inc <- pracma::trapz(
    out$time, out$incM
  )

  # Save results
  sens_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    sens_grid[i, ],

    FSW_prev = FSW_prev,
    MC_prev = MC_prev,

    FSW_integrated_incidence = FSW_int_inc,
    MC_integrated_incidence = MC_int_inc
  )
}

# 3. Combine results
sens_results <- do.call(rbind, sens_list)

# Check successful and failed simulations
cat(
  "Total combinations:", nrow(sens_results), "\n",
  "Successful runs:",
  sum(complete.cases(sens_results$FSW_prev)), "\n",
  "Failed runs:",
  sum(is.na(sens_results$FSW_prev)), "\n"
)

# Remove failed simulations for summaries and plots
sens_results_ok <- sens_results[
  complete.cases(
    sens_results[, c(
      "FSW_prev", "MC_prev",
      "FSW_integrated_incidence",
      "MC_integrated_incidence"
    )]
  ),
]

# Inspect the results
head(sens_results_ok)
summary(sens_results_ok$FSW_prev)
summary(sens_results_ok$MC_prev)

# SENSITIVITY PLOTS

# A. FSW prevalence by transmission probability and
# FSW condom coverage, faceted by FSW PrEP coverage
ggplot(
  sens_results_ok,
  aes(
    x = betaMF_scale,
    y = FSW_prev,
    colour = factor(condom_covF),
    group = interaction(
      condom_covF, betaFM_scale
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.65) +
  facet_grid(
    PrEP_covF ~ betaFM_scale,
    labeller = label_both
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity of FSW HIV Prevalence",
    x = "Male-to-FSW transmission probability scale",
    y = "Year-10 FSW HIV prevalence",
    colour = "FSW condom coverage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# B. Male client prevalence
ggplot(
  sens_results_ok,
  aes(
    x = betaFM_scale,
    y = MC_prev,
    colour = factor(condom_covM)
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = interaction(
      condom_covM, betaMF_scale
    )),
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    PrEP_covM ~ betaMF_scale,
    labeller = label_both
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sensitivity of Male Client HIV Prevalence",
    x = "FSW-to-male transmission probability scale",
    y = "Year-10 male client HIV prevalence",
    colour = "Male condom coverage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# C. Compare the distribution of prevalence outcomes
ggplot(
  sens_results_ok,
  aes(x = FSW_prev)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of FSW Prevalence Across Scenarios",
    x = "Year-10 FSW HIV prevalence",
    y = "Number of parameter combinations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(
  sens_results_ok,
  aes(x = MC_prev)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Male Client Prevalence Across Scenarios",
    x = "Year-10 male client HIV prevalence",
    y = "Number of parameter combinations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# RANK-CORRELATION SENSITIVITY SUMMARY

parameter_names <- c(
  "betaMF_scale",
  "betaFM_scale",
  "condom_covF",
  "condom_covM",
  "PrEP_covF",
  "PrEP_covM",
  "circ_cov"
)

outcome_names <- c(
  "FSW_prev",
  "MC_prev",
  "FSW_integrated_incidence",
  "MC_integrated_incidence"
)

sensitivity_correlations <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(outcome_names, function(outcome) {

    do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(parameter_names, function(parameter) {

        test <- cor.test(
          sens_results_ok[[parameter]],
          sens_results_ok[[outcome]],
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )

        data.frame(
          Parameter = parameter,
          Outcome = outcome,
          Spearman_rho = unname(test$estimate),
          p_value = test$p.value
        )
      })
    )
  })
)

# Rank strongest absolute associations within each outcome
sensitivity_correlations <- sensitivity_correlations[
  order(
    sensitivity_correlations$Outcome,
    -abs(sensitivity_correlations$Spearman_rho)
  ),
]

print(sensitivity_correlations)

# save results for the manuscript 
write.csv(
  sens_results_ok,
  "expanded_sensitivity_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  sensitivity_correlations,
  "sensitivity_rank_correlations.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
